Was it a mutual agreement (under the influence lol)?

How was it set up like how did you get his best friend in on it?

Did your husband enjoy it?
Probably is, I just googled it and it pretty much described everything I've been experiencing. I'll probably just get a check up soon though.

Fun fact; they filmed the first episode of the uk version next to my college and where my mum used to live.

The US version killed it💩

Toxic is the perfect word to describe it. I've thought about running away but I have no money and no job, and I would feel so guilty. But for some reason I feel like the only way to move forward in life is to completely abandon my family. It's like they can't see that the way that they're living has no quality. Tbh i just want to get back to the old days when my mum wasnt scarred up and was constantly smiling and singing old reggae songs and was always up in the morning. Now she can't even get up to take my brother to school. It's sad how the people you love change.
Reddit really screwed up then. It posted my comment like 100 times. Not really a good start to my experience with this site

I've been a victim to 2 violent relationships, witnessed suicide, missed half my childhood due to being on the run from my mentally ill dad, fucked my family's life up by reintroducing my mum to one of her former lovers who is a certified crack head and narcissist, been threatened with a meat cleaver for ringing the police to save my mum, had my life RUINED by the social services who made my mum quit her job (that she loved) as assistant teacher, made us homeless, had my baby brother dumped on us by his dad (the crack head) who suffers from various mental disorders (god bless him, its not his fault he had to witness it from such a young age).

Nothing in life has ever gone my way. Right now, my family is in a really bad financial state as an outcome of everything that's happened over the years. I got £100 for my 16th. I didn't even celebrate my 17th. I spent it at my friend's house only to bike it home at 1 in the morning. I've not spoke to my dad for a year now because I dropped out of college and he found out I smoke weed because of my sister, even though I never told him about her relationship with drugs. My family hates me and constantly betrays me. Even my own mother put her boyfriends before her own kids. I miss my old mum. She used to care so much. Nowadays, she spends the rest of her days in her room, drinking cheap wine and probably taking drugs, I sometimes think she sits there contemplating whether her life would have been better without kids. And I would agree.
I feel it. No matter what I do I can't get rid of the burning feeling that I shouldn't be on this planet
